name: RapidAir TLR
positioning: Specialized's lightest tubeless-ready race tire, sold as a race-day tire.
caveats: Specialized labels it 'Racing Only': a race-day tire with less protection than its training tires.
Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated.

origin.basis: Specialized Bicycle Components, Inc. publishes the US store, with California consumer disclosures in the page footer.

manufacturing.basis: Specialized does not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Sold by Specialized's US store; Specialized dealers in other regions were not checked in this pass.

price_observations.conditions: Official store sale price on 2026-11-01 (was US$109.99); one tire; shipping and tax at checkout.

image.shown: 700x28C RapidAir TLR as shown in Specialized's product photo.
image.alt: Specialized RapidAir TLR road tire with black sidewalls, standing upright

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

checks.note: Only the earlier S-Works Turbo RapidAir was tested
